t: Storage system featuring tool cart, toolbox and organiser. Ideal for larger tools. Features easily transportable cart with telescopic handle and 7" rubber wheels, and toolbox with extra-wide power tool case and removable tray. Compact and convenient organiser includes 10 multi-sized, removable and stackable bins, and transparent polycarbonate lid allowing small parts and accessories to be easily visible. Metal hinges and latches for durability. 55kg load capacity.
